summary:
Main
Today's recovery extended across futures, port spot and seaborne markets, but better prices should still be distinguished from stronger demand.DCE most-traded closed at 682.5 yuan/mt, up 1.49%; all three port indices rose, the seaborne 61% index reached USD 90.90/dmt and the 65% reached 107.95, with all 12 brands higher. Price moves were broadly aligned, yet SMM reported needs-based buying and subdued trading, leaving the rebound in need of more persistent transaction support. Supply flows and costs offer a cushion.
